_comments.threads: Number of parallel worker threads for processing images. Set to 1 for single-threaded, or use number of CPU cores for maximum speed.
_comments.min_improvement_pct: Minimum percentage size reduction required to keep a converted file. If conversion doesn't save at least this much, original is kept. Range: 0-100.
_comments.hang_timeout: Seconds to wait without progress before reporting a potential hang. Used to detect stuck conversions.
_comments.recursive: If true, processes images in subdirectories. If false, only processes top-level folder.
_comments.skip_extensions: File extensions to skip (already optimized formats). Ignored when source_extensions or --source is set. Extensions should include the leading dot (e.g., '.webp').
_comments.source_extensions: If non-empty, only these extensions are processed (e.g. ['.heic']). Empty or omitted means all supported types except skip_extensions. Overridden by --source.
_comments.jpegxl_quality: JPEG XL quality (1-100). 90 = visually lossless (cjxl default for photos). 100 = mathematically lossless, usually much larger than HEIC/JPEG.
_comments.jpegxl_effort: JPEG XL compression effort (1-10). Higher values = better compression but slower. 9 = near-maximum compression.
_comments.webp_method: WebP compression method (0-6). Higher values = better compression but slower. Does not change quality.
_comments.webp_quality: WebP quality (1-100) when webp_lossless is false. 90 is visually lossless for photos.
_comments.webp_lossless: If true, encode lossless WebP. Lossless photo WebP is typically several times larger than the source HEIC/JPEG.
_comments.jpeg_quality: Progressive JPEG quality (1-100) for {stem}.p.jpg. 90 matches the WebP default. This is a Pillow re-encode, so an existing JPEG gets a second lossy generation.
_comments.skip_second_threshold: When the first codec output is <= this fraction of original size, skip trying the second codec. Range: 0.0-1.0 (default 0.70). Lower = more compression checks; higher = faster.
_comments.adaptive_effort_enabled: If true, automatically lowers encoder effort when system load is high to reduce interference with foreground tasks.
_comments.busy_load_threshold: Normalized 1-minute system load threshold for busy mode. 1.0 means approximately one runnable task per CPU core.
_comments.jpegxl_effort_busy: JPEG XL effort (0-9) to use in busy mode. Lower is faster and lighter on CPU.
_comments.webp_method_busy: WebP method (0-6) to use in busy mode. Lower is faster and lighter on CPU.
_comments.conversion_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for a single image conversion before timing out.
_comments.max_animated_frames: Maximum number of frames to process for animated GIFs. Prevents processing extremely large animations.
_comments.log_file: Path to the log file where processing details are written.
_comments.log_verbosity: Logging verbosity level: 'DEBUG' (most verbose), 'INFO' (default), 'WARNING', or 'ERROR' (least verbose).
_comments.enable_notifications: If true, sends system notifications for completion, errors, and hang detection (macOS/Windows/Linux).
